_comment: The DMG window, in points from its top-left corner. Read by make-background.swift (what it draws) and dmgbuild-settings.py (where Finder puts the icons), so the arrow and the icons can't drift apart. The image is taller than the window: Finder's title bar takes some of the window's height, and the spare plain strip at the bottom absorbs it.

note.text: Opening it for the first time? Read Me First explains the one-time step.
